mods.name: ship-it
mods.summary: A bare "deploy it" becomes the full ship checklist
mods.where: No screen element: it adds hidden context to your prompt and shows a toast.

preview.text: Claude also reads:  Standing ship checklist: gates, version bump, PR, merge, deploy, CI, live check
toast:              ship-it: attached the ship checklist

mods.cost: A few hundred extra tokens, only on those short deploy/merge prompts.
mods.needs: A repo that documents its deploy steps (otherwise Claude stops and asks).

mods.name: deploy-verifier
mods.summary: After a push/merge/deploy: CI status and is the new version live
mods.where: A band above the prompt that appears after a push, merge or deploy command.

preview.text: deploy · ✔ CI passed (Deploy) · ✔ v3.22 is live
deploy · ✘ CI failed (Deploy) · BILLING BLOCK: Actions refused to start

mods.needs: git and the GitHub CLI (gh). Optional .claude/deploy-verify.json with a healthUrl to check the live version.

mods.name: where-are-we
mods.summary: Session-start snapshot of branch, PR, gh sign-in and dev servers
mods.where: A band above the prompt at session start, plus a /where command.

preview.text: main · 3 dirty · 2 unpushed · PR #12 OPEN · gh ✔ · up :8347 :3000
! 1 commit(s) landed upstream, possibly from another session

mods.cost: None for the band; /where adds a few hundred tokens when you run it.
mods.needs: git; gh for PR info. Runs git fetch and probes a few localhost ports at session start.

mods.name: close-out-check
mods.summary: Flags a stale CHANGELOG, version or handoff note after code changes
mods.where: A band above the prompt after any turn that changed code.

preview.text: 7 files changed, 120 insertions(+) · ! CHANGELOG not updated · version not bumped
3 files changed · ✔ docs & version look current

mods.cost: None to check; the Fix button sends one prompt.
mods.needs: A git repo. Looks for CHANGELOG.md, package.json and HANDOFF/STATUS files.

mods.name: usage-guard
mods.summary: Rate-limit usage in the status line; guards agent fan-out
mods.where: The status line, plus a toast when an agent starts near a limit.

preview.text: toast (85%+): usage-guard: 5h usage at 88% — starting "Audit sessions"
blocked (97%+): new agents are refused until the limit resets

mods.needs: A plan that reports rate-limit usage. It may replace another status line entry.

mods.name: cache-keeper
mods.summary: Prompt-cache clock with Refresh, Compress and an optional Auto keep-alive
mods.where: A band above the prompt, always on.

preview.text: cache: 47m left (60m) · last turn 92% cached · context 62% (124k/200k)
[Refresh] [Compress] [Cache lifetime: 60m · switch to 5m] [Auto: off · turn on] [Hide]
Auto paused: idle for 8h.  [Close out] [Resume (8h more)]

mods.cost: Refresh and Auto read your cached context (about 10% of normal input price). Compress is one summarizing call. Auto is off by default.
mods.needs: Nothing extra. Check the Cache lifetime button matches your plan (60m or 5m).
